create_streetlearn_engine: create a StreetLearnEngine instance from a dataset path and image dimensions
build_graph_with_root: build a navigation graph rooted at a specified panorama id
set_position_and_move: set the engine position to a panorama and move to the next pano after rotating the observer
render_observation: render a panoramic observation into a numpy buffer of ubyte values
get_neighbor_occupancy: get the occupancy status of neighboring panos at a given position
